text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that studies cross-border transactions of goods and services, international capital flows, and the coordination of economic policies, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, management, law, and statistics. This major focuses on global resource allocation, international trade rules, and cross-border business operations, aiming to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective and practical abilities, and to meet the demands of fields such as cross-border trade, international investment, and cross-border e-commerce in the context of globalization.
